name: Offcn Education Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Offcn Education Technology Co., Ltd. operates as a multi-category vocational education institution in China. The company provides public service recruitment examination training, academic qualification, and professional qualification and professional ability training services. It also offers educational technology consulting, technology development, technology promotion, technology transfer, and technical services; educational consulting; cultural consulting; enterprise management consulting services; enterprise investment consulting; computer technology training services; public relations services; conference services; human resources services.
